fields.Text: In linear algebra, a matrix {{c1::determinant}} equal to 0 means the transformation collapses volume to zero.
fields.Extra: No inverse matrix exists when det(A) = 0.

fields.Text: To execute a synchronous blocking function inside an `async def` endpoint without blocking the Event Loop, wrap it using `await {{c1::run_in_threadpool(func, *args)}}` or `await {{c1::asyncio.to_thread(func, *args)}}`.
fields.Extra: This offloads the blocking synchronous call to the AnyIO threadpool while returning an awaitable future to the main Event Loop, keeping the server non-blocking.

fields.Text: In FastAPI, an `async def` endpoint runs directly on the single-threaded Event Loop and only yields execution to other tasks at {{c1::explicit `await` points}}.
fields.Extra: Without an explicit yield point (`await`), any synchronous or CPU-heavy operation inside `async def` blocks the single Event Loop thread, preventing all other incoming requests from being processed.

fields.Text: When an endpoint is defined using standard `def` (without async), FastAPI automatically runs it off the main Event Loop inside a {{c1::Threadpool (via AnyIO)}}.
fields.Extra: Blocking operations inside a standard `def` endpoint only hold up that worker thread in the threadpool, while the main Event Loop remains completely free to handle other requests.

fields.Text: To run independent coroutines concurrently and reduce total wait time to the single longest request, pass un-awaited coroutine objects to `await {{c1::asyncio.gather(coro1, coro2, ...)}}`.
fields.Extra: Do not use `await` on individual function calls inside `gather(...)`, as that forces them to execute sequentially before `gather` is even invoked.

fields.Text: Calling synchronous database drivers (e.g., `psycopg2`) directly inside `async def` causes {{c1::Event Loop thread freezing}}. To fix this with sync drivers, define the endpoint using standard {{c2::`def`}}.
fields.Extra: Using synchronous DB drivers inside `async def` freezes the main Event Loop. Use async drivers (`asyncpg` + `AsyncSession`) for `async def`, or use standard `def` endpoints for synchronous drivers (`psycopg2`).

fields.Text: In FastAPI, define endpoints as `async def` when using {{c1::natively async libraries}}, and standard `def` when using {{c2::synchronous blocking libraries}}.
fields.Extra: Use `async def` for native async drivers (`httpx`, `asyncpg`), standard `def` for sync libraries (`requests`, `psycopg2`), and `BackgroundTasks` for non-blocking long operations like sending emails.
